map.输入基准地价或路线价，并设置年期、期日、容积率、区域与个别因素修正系数，自动计算: Enter the base or route land price and set adjustments for term, date, plot ratio, locational and individual factors to compute the adjusted unit land price and total land price.

map.路线价 = 基准价×深度×宽深修正: Route price = base price × depth × width-depth adjustment
map.💡 修正后地价 = 基准地价 × 年期修正 × 期日修正 × 容积率修正 × 区: 💡 Adjusted land price = base land price × term adjustment × date adjustment × plot ratio adjustment × locational adjustment × individual adjustment × development level adjustment × other adjustment.
map.年期修正系数采用收益还原法公式：K = [1 − 1/(1+r)ⁿ] / [1: The term factor uses the income reversion formula K = [1 − 1/(1+r)ⁿ] / [1 − 1/(1+r)ᵐ], where r is the land reversion rate and m the statutory maximum term
map.不同用途法定最高年限不同：住宅 70 年、商业 40 年、工业 50 年、办公: Statutory maximum terms differ by use: residential 70 years, commercial 40, industrial 50 and office 50
map.各修正系数由市/县基准地价修正体系确定，本工具使用默认值仅供参考: Adjustment factors come from the city or county base land price system; the tool uses defaults for reference only
map.路线价法还需考虑深度、宽度、形状等临街条件修正: The route price method also needs adjustments for depth, width, shape and other frontage conditions
map.📚 深度解析：土地基准地价系数修正: 📚 In-depth: Base Land Price Coefficient Adjustment
map.按基准地价乘年期与各项系数求修正后地价。: Multiply the base land price by the term and other factors for the adjusted price.
map.对比住宅/商业/工业不同年期修正。: Compare term adjustments across residential, commercial and industrial use.
map.算总地价判断是否超预算。: Compute the total land price to see whether it exceeds budget.
map.基准地价 4000 元/㎡、住宅 r=5%、使用年限 70 年（=上限）→ 年期: Base price 4000 yuan/sqm, residential r = 5%, term 70 years (the maximum) gives a term factor of 1.0; with a date factor of 1.05 and plot ratio factor of 1.10 the adjusted unit price = 4000 × 1.0 × 1.05 × 1.10 = 4620 yuan/sqm; 5000 sqm gives a total land price of 23.1 million yuan.
map.若剩余年限仅 40 年（上限 70），年期系数=(1−1.05^−40)/(1−: With only 40 years remaining (against a 70-year maximum) the term factor = (1−1.05^−40)/(1−1.05^−70) ≈ 0.95, so the adjusted unit price falls to about 4390 yuan/sqm and the total land price by about 1.15 million yuan.
map.年期修正系数为什么≤1？: Why is the term factor at most 1?
map.使用年限越短价值越低，系数=(1−(1+r)^−实际)/(1−(1+r)^−上限: A shorter term means lower value; the factor = (1−(1+r)^−actual)/(1−(1+r)^−maximum), equal to 1 at the maximum and below 1 otherwise.
map.路线价和基准地价区别？: How do route price and base land price differ?
map.基准地价是片区均价，路线价是临街深度修正价，商业临街用地常用路线价法，住宅多用基: Base land price is the district average, while route price is the frontage-adjusted price; commercial frontage land commonly uses the route price method and residential the base land price adjustment.

map.基准地价系数修正（本页代码口径）：年期修正系数=(1−1÷(1+r)^t)÷(1: Benchmark land price coefficient adjustment (as coded on this page): term adjustment factor = (1−1÷(1+r)^t)÷(1−1÷(1+r)^M), where r is the capitalization rate by use (residential 5%, commercial 6%, industrial 5%, office 5.5%) and M the legal maximum term (residential 70 / commercial 40 / industrial 50 / office 50 years), with t the remaining term (capped at M); adjusted unit land price = benchmark price×term×date×plot ratio×regional×individual×development×other adjustments (all multiplied); total land price = unit price×area. Validation: benchmark price and area must be >0 and the term ≥1, otherwise the page asks for valid benchmark price, land area and term and stops. Verdict: no fixed grading; the combined adjustment factor (adjusted÷benchmark) is shown for review.
